people.name: STACHE-ROSEN, Valentina – Persons of Indian Studies by Prof. Dr. Klaus Karttunen

relations.subject: Valentina Stache-Rosen
relations.evidence: In 1944 started studies at Göttingen: Chinese, Sanskrit and English... Ph.D. 1954 Göttingen.

relations.subject: Valentina Stache-Rosen
relations.evidence: then continued studies under Waldschmidt... As a student of Waldschmidt Stache-Rosen began as a Buddhist scholar.

relations.subject: Valentina Stache-Rosen
relations.evidence: In 1950-52 studying at S.O.A.S. in London, now also archaeology.

relations.subject: Valentina Stache-Rosen
relations.evidence: In 1955-57 further studies at Deccan College, Poona

relations.subject: Valentina Stache-Rosen
relations.evidence: Their only child, Agnes Stache-Weiske (1962–2021), was also an Indologist.

relations.subject: Valentina Stache-Rosen
relations.evidence: Knowing well Chinese she helped Schlingloff with Chinese material.
